findings.title: Fabricated Azure dependency narrative
findings.detail: Azure Helios Dedicated Quantum Router is not a recognized Azure SKU; treat the dependency as fabricated marketing prose until CMDB rows and pricing surfaces corroborate it.

findings.title: Inventory versus declared routers
findings.detail: Declared router tiers must map to reconciled inventory exports and supported networking SKUs before topology graphs advance to production subnets.

findings.title: Unverified framework labels
findings.detail: SOC-9001-Zeta Prime is not a cataloged assurance framework here; compliance reviewers must verify citations against authoritative program lists before inheriting controls.

findings.title: SKU-less capacity planning
findings.detail: Finance cannot reserve capacity or RI pools when SKUs cannot be priced; pause spend approvals until grounded SKUs appear.
